options.name: config
options.description: Path to the Forgejo configuration file.

options.name: email
options.description: Email address of the Forgejo user. Required when I(state=present) and the user does not yet exist.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the Forgejo user. Required when I(state=present) and the user does not yet exist.

options.name: state
options.description: Target state of the user. C(present) ensures the user exists. C(absent) is currently not supported and will return without changes.

options.name: username
options.description: The Forgejo username to create if it does not exist.

options.name: working_dir
options.description: Path to the Forgejo working directory. This is typically the home directory of the Forgejo service user.
